data is the raw calldata forwarded to callee.delegatecall inside delegateTo
amount directly parameterizes the pot pie calculation and exit size
from is the ERC20 source used by transferFrom inside doTransferIn
daiJoinAddress_ is the caller-supplied address persisted into daiJoinAddress
potAddress_ is the caller-supplied address persisted into potAddress
pie is a transient read used only to compute the returned cash value
bal is a transient vat balance used only to size the pot join
